title: From Proposal to Verified Effect: Praxa, an Evidence-Bound Harness for Governed AI Agent Execution
abstract: arXiv:2610.00015v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large-language-model agents can propose and execute actions, but proposal, authority, dispatch, verified external effect, and serving promotion are different claims. We present Praxa, an agent harness that represents these states explicitly through deterministic admission, brokered execution, external read-back, reconciliation, and reviewed promotion. We report four evidence lanes. First, an author-run repository-local audit at a pinned revision passed 1,027/1,027 unit tests and 89/89 Workerd tests, instrumented all 363 expected source files, and met four coverage floors; raw per-test transcripts and independent reproduction are unavailable. Second, in a provider-backed Terminal-Bench Core 0.1.1 pilot across 12 curated tasks, baseline and reliability-layer arms each passed 17/36 strict trials. translated_title: 从提议到已验证效果：Praxa，一个面向可治理AI智能体执行的证据绑定框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.00015v1 公告类型：new 摘要：大语言模型智能体可以提出并执行动作，但提议、授权、分发、已验证的外部效果以及服务上线是彼此不同的声明。我们提出了Praxa，一个智能体框架，它通过确定性准入、代理式执行、外部读回、对账核验以及经审查的上线，将这些状态显式地表示出来。我们报告了四条证据通道。第一，在固定修订版本上进行的作者自运行的仓库本地审计通过了1,027/1,027个单元测试和89/89个Workerd测试，对全部363个预期源文件进行了插桩，并满足了四个覆盖率下限；但原始的逐测试转录文本和独立复现不可用。第二，在一个基于服务提供商的Terminal-Bench Core 0.1.1试点中，跨12个精选任务，基线组和可靠性层组各自通过了17/36次严格试验。可靠性层多消耗了37.49%的输入令牌和50.73%的输出令牌，因此该试点不支持其具有优越性的结论。第三，在调试后的两项……
tldr: Praxa通过确定性准入、代理式执行、外部读回、对账核验与审查上线五个环节，将AI智能体的提议、授权、分发、已验证外部效果和服务上线等不同状态显式分离并以证据绑定，从而实现可治理、可审计的智能体执行。
en_tdlr: Praxa is an evidence-bound agent harness that explicitly separates proposal, authority, dispatch, verified external effect, and serving promotion through deterministic admission, brokered execution, external read-back, reconciliation, and reviewed promotion, enabling governed and auditable AI agent execution.
